items.title: Daniela Sepehri
points: What does the Future hold for Iran?
items.desc: Daniela Sepehri is a journalist, activist, and author. Among other things, she focuses on the human rights situation in Iran.

items.title: Arne Semsrott
points: Eat the Rich - Grasroots Class Struggle
items.desc: Arne is the director and editor-in-chief of FragDenStaat. He is a political scientist and journalist. Through the Freiheitsfonds, he helps free people from prison. His bestseller "Gegenmacht" ("Counterforce") was published in 2026.

items.title: Bianca Nawrath
points: Shame & Sex: Writing Erotic Fiction and Overcoming Resistance
items.desc: Bianca Nawrath is an author and actress with Polish roots. Born in Berlin in 1997, she first appeared on camera at the age of 14 as the presenter of a youth programme. She made her acting debut in 2018 and has since appeared alongside Judi Dench and Jürgen Vogel, among others. Her first novel, *Eat This Now, If You Love Me*, was published in 2021, followed most recently by *Beautiful Shame* (2025) with Frankfurter Verlagsanstalt. Bianca Nawrath lives and works in Berlin.

items.title: Vanessa Faloye
items.desc: Hosted by Vanessa Faloye (aka DJ inda Flo) who works in anti-oppression, conflict transformation, and movement-building as part of her co-founded collective called Held, based in the UK.

items.title: Melanie Wolfers
points: Imagine that the Future will be bright
items.desc: Melanie Wolfers is described by many as an “inspirer.” She is a podcaster (GANZ SCHÖN MUTIG) and bestselling author, and she counsels young adults. She is guided by the motto: “Discover and live your true greatness.” Melanie has been meditating since she was 13 and lives in a Christian religious community. Her book “Take Away Powerlessness’s Power. Discover the Strength That Dwells Within You” inspired the festival’s theme.

items.title: Lindi Delight
points: Panel: Money & Power in Cultural Creation – aktuelle Situation/ Shift in der Kulturszene
items.desc: Lindi Delight is a transformation architect and dual-certified coach who has spent nearly two decades shaping the future of global music events and culture. With a background directing international brand tours for artists such as Chris Liebing (CLR), Dj Tennis (Life and Death), and Lee Burridge (All Day I Dream), managing teams across continents, and leading complex organizational change, she brings rare fluency in both creativity and strategic execution. Her consulting portfolio has included Most Wanted: Music, Boiler Room, XP Music Futures, and The Beatport Group, where she designed conferences, restructured operations, and fostered cultures of inclusion and innovation. She became known for creating forward-thinking and dynamic systems and processes that shift how organizations conne...

items.title: Sophia Fritz & Christina Lehr
items.desc: Sophia Fritz (b. 1997) studied screenwriting at the Munich Film School. Her book »Toxische Weiblichkeit« (Toxic Femininity) became a SPIEGEL bestseller in 2024. Christina Lehr (Stina, b. 1982) is a midwife, tantric masseuse and Gestalt therapist. Together they co-lead ehrlichleben since 2025 – somatic exploration spaces for bodywork and solidary sisterhood.

items.title: Laurie Penny
items.desc: Laurie Penny is a journalist, screenwriter, activist and the author of nine books, including ‚Sexual Revolution: Modern Fascism and the Feminist Fightback.'

items.title: Friederike von Aderkas
items.desc: WutKraft Trainerin, Autorin, Diplom Pädagogin, Systemische Coachin und Mutter Über acht Jahre Erfahrung im Zusammenleben, Forschen und Wirken in einer 120 köpfigen Gemeinschaft Mit Herzblut fühlende, lernende und lehrende  Gefühls- und Beziehungsforschende, mit Hang zur Intensität und dem Wunsch nach echter Tiefe und Verbindung im zwischenmenschlichen Kontakt. Schnell gelangweilt von Oberflächlichkeit und Smalltalk. Ich sehe meine Wirksamkeit im authentischen Miteinander sein und Räume für echte Begegnungen öffnen – Zuerst im Kontakt mit dir selbst und dann auch mit den anderen.

items.title: Goldie
items.desc: Goldie is a multidisciplinary artist, dancer and researcher whose practice intertwines movement, critical reflection and visual media, producing knowledge from Black interiorities. Drawing expressive force from whacking and punking, influenced by jazz, soul and funk, she has performed at Les Nuits de Fourvière (Lyon) and Le Carreau du Temple (Paris).

items.title: Helena Steinhaus
points: Eat the Rich - Grasroots Class Struggle
items.desc: Helena Steinhaus is an author and the founder of the Sanktionsfrei association, which campaigns for a basic income that ensures human dignity. The association provides financial and legal support to people receiving basic income, whilst also focusing on ongoing public awareness-raising work on the issues of unemployment and poverty.

items.title: Sanle Tong
items.desc: Sanle (pronounced san-lee) is a yoga and Pilates teacher from Berlin. As a trainee psychotherapist, she is particularly interested in the relationship between body, mind, and emotional wellbeing. In her workshops she explores themes such as self-love, confidence, boundaries, and the mind-body connection.

items.title: Noreen Reiter & Samuel Friedl
items.desc: Noreen: was in charge for branding at Amorelie and Satisfyer and is now working on her own idea in Berlin. She is a great dancer. Samuel: coaches executives at large cooperations and is now also a “Gestalt” therapist and psychedelic therapist.

items.title: Nessa Schnessa
items.desc: Always wanted to glide across the asphalt on roller skates while jamming to music – but never dared? Then grab your...

items.title: Isabelle Dikumbi
points: Landing Softly: A Closing Journey of Reflection & Integration
This Is your Moment – The Art of being alive
items.desc: Isabelle Dikumbi Rivera has been working in Berlin since 2016 at the intersection of activism, healing, and community building. As a yoga teacher, space holder and empowerment facilitator, she creates spaces for BIPOC communities, queer people and those affected by structural discrimination. In 2020 she founded Germany's first BIPOC yoga retreat, 'Nourish Your Soul'.

items.title: Sascha Möckel
points: Men* Between Criticism, Overwhelm, and Positive Masculinity
items.desc: Sascha Möckel is a social educator and for over eight years a board member of Männernetzwerk Dresden e.V., one of Germany's leading organizations for professional work with men and boys. He advocates for gender-sensitive approaches, dismantling toxic role models, and equality across all genders – from a pro-feminist perspective.

items.title: Johanna Schuck
items.desc: Johanna spent five years working at Sisyphos, so she knows what happens when people are tired and feelings run high. These days, she transforms that experience into workshops on communication, conflict, and connection, drawing mostly on Nonviolent Communication and mediation. She helps people find the words – and the curiosity – to navigate what's hard. She takes pleasure in connecting what seems opposite, like working with her own team of AI agents while also researching how to learn from nature's ability to process transformation

items.title: Toni Kircheis
points: Your Inner Team on the Dance Floor
items.desc: Toni Kircheis, born 1989 in Berlin, is a systemic therapist supporting individuals, couples and groups in discovering new perspectives on themselves. His workshops combine systemic approaches, body awareness and interaction – rooted in the fascination that we are each made up of many inner parts

items.title: Storm Willow Hartley
items.desc: Storm is a sound artist, eternal student, and yogic guide. Through embodied listening and contemplative practice, her work explores the subtle body, the nervous system, and the cultivation of collective states of remembrance, connection, and transformation.

items.title: Anna Gamburg
items.desc: My name is Anna Gamburg and I have taken on many shapes and forms: For over 12 years I have been working as a voice actress and actress and explored many roles. In the last 5 years I have breached out into coaching and empowering people to reconnect with their authenticity and joy. Playing improv theater for many years was one of my own first steps into this self expression. Tapping into joy is what I desire to share with the world!

items.title: Ahmad Dakhnous
points: Making the Israel-Palestine Issue Open to Discussion
items.desc: Christoph holds degrees in Islamic studies, political science and history; he lived in Jerusalem, working in political education for the Friedrich Ebert Foundation. Ahmad is a political scientist and educator on racism, antisemitism, displacement and Palestine-Israel. Both have been part of the Gesellschaft im Wandel education team since 2024.

items.title: Pia Zulauf, Marietta Hollensteiner
items.desc: Marietta loves creating spaces where people can simply be. Trained in Jin Shin Jyutsu and fascia work, she teaches Hatha, Vinyasa and Yin Yoga in Berlin. Pia studies psychology, is a critical wilderness educator, and works occasionally in circus therapy. Both love watching genuine connections form between people.

items.title: Vanessa Martin
points: Human Tides: On a cyclical Life in a linear World
items.desc: After navigating my own health struggles, I discovered a different way, which works with the body, not against it. Now, as a certified Menstrual Cycle Coach with a trauma-informed approach, I help others do the same to reconnect to their cycle again

items.title: Pasquale Virginie Rotter
points: Deep Landing: Arriving Before Saying Goodbye
items.desc: #thelovinggaze has been accompanying people through times of change and transformation for nearly 20 years

items.title: Christoph Dinkelacker
points: Making the Israel-Palestine Issue Open to Discussion
items.desc: Christoph ist studierter Islam-, Politik und Geschichtswissenschaftler. Er hat mehrere Jahre in Jerusalem gelebt und dort sowohl in der politischen Bildungsarbeit für die Friedrich-Ebert-Stiftung als auch in der grenzübergreifenden Dialogarbeit mit Israelis und Palästinenser*innen am Willy Brandt Center gearbeitet. Während seiner Zeit in Jerusalem hat der Mitgründer von Alsharq zahlreiche Artikel zu politischen Entwicklungen vor Ort geschrieben und unter anderem ein Kompendium zu palästinensischen Parteien und Bewegungen veröffentlicht. Seit 15 Jahren konzipiert und leitet Christoph zudem politische Studienreisen in Israel & Palästina. Seit 2024 ist er Teil des Bildungsteams der Gesellschaft im Wandel.

items.title: Maria Salichow & Theresa Stöhr
items.desc: Theresa and Maria from Casa Nostra have been creating spaces for genuine connection and movement together since 2023. Maria brings her experience as a dance-yoga teacher, Theresa her passion for Vinyasa yoga and acrobatics. Both are trained yoga teachers united by a love of creativity, movement and playful togetherness.

items.title: Vulvaa Power
points: We are coming out – Free the Nipple
items.desc: At Vulvaa Power, we believe that personal transformation creates collective change. Through embodiment, self-awareness, and connection, we support people in reclaiming their power and living more authentically.

items.title: Joy Dorkhom
items.desc: Hello hello! My name is Joy! I have experienced since the last 10 years the joy of being on both sides of the canvas. Being an artist and architect on one side, and nude model on the other side, i experience the enrichment of both creation and posing that i would love to share with everybody !

items.title: Juli Hauser & Natalie Krug
points: From Rooting to Rising - How the Dancefloor can become a Healing Space
items.desc: Als Psychologiestudentin (Juli), Yogalehrerin (Natalie) und leidenschaftliche Tanzbegeisterte wissen wir, wie kraftvoll, verbindend und transformierend die Erfahrung von Körper, Bewegung und Klang sein kann. Für uns sind Raves mehr als nur Partys: Sie sind Orte der Begegnung und des Staunens – Räume, in denen wir die Magie des Lebendigseins spüren können.

items.title: Crispin Bade & Lara Pickener
items.desc: Crispin Bade is a circus educator and performer from Berlin, co-founder of the KNOT Collective for participatory contemporary circus. Lara Pickener is a licensed psychotherapist specializing in Systemic Therapy with over ten years of clinical experience, combining systemic thinking with a body-oriented perspective.

items.title: Alex Cuthbertson & Jo Schubert
points: Trippin' with Cyberdelics — No Substances Required
items.desc: Alexx Kaos is an inventor at the intersection of self-reflection and technological neuromodulation – physicist, theatre-maker and artist. Jo is a scientist and curious explorer across computer science, cognitive science and design thinking, asking how emerging technologies can help us think and decide better together.

items.title: Jessie Sonnenschein
items.desc: Jessie has lived the highs and lows of 20+ years experience in nightlife and festivals across London and Berlin, and found new depth in sobriety. In the variety of workshops she facilitates, she brings together her passion for connection, creativity, dress up and conscious celebration.

items.title: Rita Maglio & Jana Pfenning von Better Birth Control
points: The Path to Equal Access to Contraception
items.desc: Better Birth Control e.V. is a nonprofit working since 2021 to make contraception better and more equitable for all genders. They conduct inclusive educational outreach, advocate for more research into new contraceptives, and campaign for full coverage by health insurance companies.

items.title: Reinhild Benning
points: Shopping in a way that’s good for the climate and people—how can that work?
items.desc: Reinhild Benning is a farmer and activist for healthy food and a healthy planet, fighting for human rights in supply chains and more plant-based foods. She is co-author of the FLEISCHATLAS and co-organizer of the 'Wir haben es satt' demonstration for climate-just agriculture and food democracy.

items.title: celephais & uhuspecht
items.desc: We have been active as activists for years and organize events on the topics of free software, digital self-defense, and data protection. We are members of c-base, the largest and oldest hackspace in Europe.

items.title: Sonja Werner
items.desc: Sonja ist Sexual- und Traumatherapeutin, Paarcoachin, Tantra-Masseurin und seit Anbeginn auf den Bucht-Floors dabei.

items.title: Elise Alma
items.desc: Sonja is a sexual and trauma therapist, couples coach, tantric masseuse, and a Bucht floor regular from the very beginning. Anna is a dancer and raver who sings, DJs and accompanies people through transformative processes. Together, the two bring voice, sound, body and play together.

items.title: Sophie Victoria Lauber
points: Reset & Reconnect – Back to the Here and Now in 90 Minutes
items.desc: Sophie Victoria Lauber is a trauma-informed educator (DeGPT) with many years of experience in psychosocial work. She supports professionals, teams and groups in remaining capable of action even in challenging situations, combining trauma-informed knowledge with body-oriented, practical everyday methods.

items.title: Toomuch by Tanzen3000
items.desc: Tanzen3000 is a Berlin-based collective with backgrounds in DJing, dance, rapping, somatics, and nightlife activism. Their sessions invite everyone – with or without dance experience – who wants more physically and socially connected parties. In guided activations, they share free movement concepts you can instantly play with on the dancefloor.

items.title: Simone Burster
items.desc: Before the festival buzz awakens, give yourself a magical start to the day. With mindful flows, grounding standing poses and conscious breath, ...

items.title: Júlia von Montfort & Ashraf Alali
points: Slow the F*ck Down: A Restorative Yoga Experience
items.desc: Júlia (Shakti) and Ashrif (Shiva) warmly welcome you to a connective, releasing journey where the energies of Sun (Surya) and Moon (Chandra) meet in sacred union. with practices that will be powerful and strong, elevanting your energy and vibration for the festival in combination with Kundalini Kriyas and Tantric Exercises connection.

items.title: Heidi van de Flausen
items.desc: Heidi van de Flausen is a yoga teacher, Reiki master, and somatic facilitator. She helps people reconnect with their bodies, energy, and inner wisdom. Her work is based on somatic embodiment and the chakra system, guiding through movement, breath, and mindfulness

items.title: A Quarter to Infinity
items.desc: A crafty and meditative workshop inviting participants to create their own miniature planets from recycled materials, textures, and found objects. Inspired by

items.title: Emiko Gejic
points: Panel: Hedonism vs. Community Activation – How to reconnect (or get active) despite Feelings of Powerlessness
Panel: Money & Power in Cultural Creation – aktuelle Situation/ Shift in der Kulturszene
items.desc: Emiko Gejic is a creative, cultural producer and activist from Berlin. She is the founder of Berlinsidestories, managing director of Urbane Praxis, and official spokesperson of the Berlin Clubcommission. With a background in cultural studies and urban research, she advocates for Berlin's nightlife, subcultures and more equitable urban futures

items.title: Hannah Pascucci
items.desc: Hannah is a yoga teacher and founder of Courage Yoga – a space for mindful movement, honest feeling, and genuine connection. She sees yoga not as performance, but as a way to reconnect with the body. Based in Berlin, she teaches in studios and through accessible outdoor classes, creating spaces where community and belonging can truly be felt.

items.title: Glitzzy Goerlitzzy
items.desc: Glitzzy is the creator's creative alter ego, under which she offers hands-on activities and festival workshops for the individual embellishment of headgear. According to the respective personalities! Just for the fun of us all!

items.title: Avy
items.desc: Material and sustainability nerd. At the same time, fully in my body. At some point came the question: what if you combine both? Ever since, I've been somewhere in that experiment between material and body.

items.title: Rückenwind
items.desc: Rückenwind e. V. is a Berlin-based nonprofit organization that has been collecting, repairing, and distributing donated bicycles to people who have fled to Berlin since 2015. In open workshops, volunteers and refugees learn bicycle repair together, share knowledge, and create access to sustainable mobility. Rückenwind stands for community, solidarity, integration, and the right to repair

items.title: Tarot Reader
items.desc: During the day, the Peepshow transforms into a space for creative and participatory encounters, including intimate tarot reading experiences and one-to-one interactions with festival visitors.

items.title: Julia Kefer
items.desc: Julia (juliaflowsgeen) aus Wien ist Lehrerin für bewusste, körperbezogene Liebe. In ihren nährenden Räumen erkundest du dich anhand spiritueller und yogischer Prinzipien. Durch sanfte Neugier und somatische Übungen entfalten sich Freiheit, Selbstermächtigung und eine tiefere Verbindung zu dir selbst.

items.title: Lena Prieß
items.desc: Lena ist Osteopathin und ehemalige Geigerin. Sie lebt in Berlin und für die Musik und den Tanz. Sie hat diesen Workshop ins Leben gerufen, um etwas von der Leidenschaft und Freude weiterzugeben, die sie auf so vielen Tanzflächen rund um die Welt erlebt haben.

items.title: Nina Javshanashvili & Tekla Tevdorashvili
items.desc: Tekla and Nina are two friends from Tbilisi whose worlds came together through a shared love of music and nature. Tekla is an artivist and producer, Nina a label manager and animal rights activist. Their work with herbs began with Nina's thyroid disease – today they help people reconnect with themselves through healing plants.

items.title: Hæppy Änna & Duchesne
items.desc: Tight and tense? Learn 3 easy self-massage techniques for everyday, work, or rave-related tension. SHAKE THAT ASS: vibration, shaking, tapping. FASCINATING FASCIA: from stiffness

items.title: Melanie Sichardt & André Richter
items.desc: A journey triggered by frequencies, vibrations and sounds that help you dive into yourself and into the present moment

items.title: Svenja Reese
points: Please put your phone away! Swap your screen for the moment.
items.desc: Svenja Reese studierte Digitale Medienkulturen an der Filmuniversität Babelsberg KONRAD WOLF und beschäftigt sich seit vielen Jahren mit der Frage, wie digitale Technologien unser Zusammenleben, unsere Aufmerksamkeit und unsere Kultur prägen.

items.title: Line Kiekbusch & Elias Manzel
points: RIGHT HERE – RIGHT NOW: Political Graffiti as a Voice in Public Spaces
items.desc: We are a group with a background in graffiti who have explored politically motivated graffiti.

items.title: Annie Witschas & Valentina Vavalà & Gusztáv Ottrubay
points: To grow or not to grow? Ideas for a fair and sustainable Future
items.desc: We are a group of alumni of the Degrowth Master at the Autonomous University Barcelona, excited to share ideas of a sustainable and just future for all.

items.title: Annie Strout
items.desc: Journey through layers of healing, the spirit and greater consciousness to resolve wounds, access guidance and upgrade your connection to higher dimensions....

items.title: Anuschka Loose
items.desc: Anuschka Loose (Berlin, 1997) is a performer and maker. Shaped by Fusion Belly Dance, Physical Theatre, the ATE Method and somatic practices, she graduated in 2025 from Fontys Hogeschool voor de Kunsten (NL) with a BA in Dance and Choreography. Her works range from solos to public space interventions

items.title: Miriam Lütt
points: Right Here, Right Now – Gentle Yoga Flow
Yin Yoga, Voice & Breathwork – Together in the Moment
items.desc: Miriam Lütt is a yoga teacher from Berlin, teaching at studios and festivals for more than 6 years. Her classes combine movement, breath, and sound into a vibrant practice. Her goal is to create spaces where connection, balance, and authentic sensation can flourish – right in the midst of the festival.

items.title: Pauline Jäckels
points: Panel: Hedonism vs. Community Activation – How to reconnect (or get active) despite Feelings of Powerlessness
items.desc: Pauline Jäckels is a journalist, editor and moderator based in Berlin. She writes on international politics, social movements and questions of democracy, with a particular focus on global justice and foreign policy. Alongside her work as an editor at taz, she co-hosts the podcast Weltunordnung, where she discusses current international affairs with experts and activists.

items.title: Luise Klingma
points: Panel: Hedonism vs. Community Activation – How to reconnect (or get active) despite Feelings of Powerlessness
items.desc: Liese Kingma is a cultural practitioner, strategist and community advocate based in Berlin. Her work explores how culture, participation and community-building can create more accessible and inclusive public spaces. Through research, facilitation and international collaborations, she develops projects that strengthen cultural resilience and social connection.

items.title: Zuher Jazmati
points: Panel: Hedonism vs. Community Activation – How to reconnect (or get active) despite Feelings of Powerlessness
items.desc: Zuher Jazmati is a political educator, moderator, DJ and podcaster based in Berlin. His work focuses on anti-racism, queer politics, intersectionality and anti-discrimination, combining political education with cultural practice. As co-host of the award-winning BBQ – The Black Brown Queer Podcast and co-founder of the queer-Arab party series ADIRA, he creates spaces that foster dialogue, visibility and community.

items.title: Alexander Krüger
points: Panel: Money & Power in Cultural Creation – aktuelle Situation/ Shift in der Kulturszene
items.desc: Alexander Krüger is a cultural entrepreneur, musician and co-founder of the Feel Festival. For over two decades, he has been creating festivals and cultural spaces at the intersection of music, art and community, including Feel Festival, Artlake, Whole Festival and Berlin's Alte Münze. His work explores how culture can create meaningful connections and inspire new ways of living together.

items.title: Thomas Scheele
points: Panel: Money & Power in Cultural Creation – aktuelle Situation/ Shift in der Kulturszene
items.desc: Thomas (he/they) is a Senior Project Manager at VibeLab in Berlin with over 15 years of experience in nightlife as a performer, event host, promoter and venue operator, alongside a decade of work in nightlife advocacy.

items.title: Zuzu
items.desc: Zuzu ist DJ und tanzt seit vielen Jahren.
